SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL UIO CORDOVEZ'
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'CORDOVEZ GUAYAQUIL' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL GYE CORDOVEZ'
    ELSE T3.WhsName
    END AS "location",
    T1.ItemCode AS "code",
    T0.DocDate AS "date",
    T1.Quantity AS "quantity"
FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OINV T0
JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.INV1 T1 ON T1.DocEntry = T0.DocEntry
JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITM T2 ON T2.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 ON T3.WhsCode = T1.WhsCode
WHERE 
T0.U_DOC_DECLARABLE = 'S' AND
T0.DocDate  BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CAST(GETDATE() as DATE)
AND  T3.WhsName IN ('ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO','CORDOVEZ GUAYAQUIL')
Order By T1.WhsCode, T1.ItemCode, T0.DocDate

SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL UIO VID'
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'VIDINTERNACIONAL GUAYAQUIL' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL GYE VID'
    ELSE T3.WhsName
    END AS "location",
    T1.ItemCode AS "code",
    T0.DocDate AS "date",
    T1.Quantity AS "quantity"
FROM [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.OINV T0
JOIN [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.INV1 T1 ON T1.DocEntry = T0.DocEntry
JOIN [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.OITM T2 ON T2.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
JOIN [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 ON T3.WhsCode = T1.WhsCode

T0.U_DOC_DECLARABLE = 'S' AND
T0.DocDate  BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CAST(GETDATE() as DATE)
AND  T3.WhsName IN ('ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO','VIDINTERNACIONAL GUAYAQUIL')
Order By T1.WhsCode, T1.ItemCode, T0.DocDate

SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL UIO IMNAC'
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'IMNAC GUAYAQUIL' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL GYE IMNAC'
    ELSE T3.WhsName
    END AS "location",

FROM [DB_IMNAC_PROD].dbo.OINV T0

JOIN [DB_IMNAC_PROD].dbo.OITM T2 ON T2.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
JOIN [DB_IMNAC_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 ON T3.WhsCode = T1.WhsCode

T0.U_DOC_DECLARABLE = 'S' AND

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL UIO CORDOVEZ'
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'CORDOVEZ GUAYAQUIL' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL GYE CORDOVEZ'
    ELSE T3.WhsName
    END AS "location",
    T0.ItemCode          AS "code",
    T0.ItemName          AS "description",
    'finished'           AS "materialType",
    CAST(T0.NumInBuy AS INT) AS "multipleOrderQuantity",
    'USD'                AS "currency",
    T0.AvgPrice          AS "unitCost",
   CAST(T0.NumInBuy AS INT)     AS "minimumOrderQuantity",
    'units'              AS "unitOfMeasure",
    CAST(ISNULL(T9.U_DIAS_PRODUCCION, 0) AS INT) AS "supplyLeadTime",
    T1.OnHand            AS "onHandStock",
    CASE 
        -- Si el proveedor es PERNOD RICARD COLOMBIA S.A. o RUM TRADING INTERNACIONAL CORP, 
        -- mostrar transitStock en ALMACEN GENERAL GYE
        WHEN (T8.SuppName = 'PRATAC S.A.' OR T8.SuppName = 'PERNOD RICARD COLOMBIA S.A.' OR T8.SuppName = 'RUM TRADING INTERNACIONAL CORP') 
             AND T3.WhsName = 'ALMACEN GENERAL GYE' THEN 
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(p1.Quantity * p1.NumPerMsr) 
                    FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.POR1 p1
                    LEFT JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OPOR op ON op.DocEntry = p1.DocEntry 
                    WHERE op.DocStatus = 'O' AND op.Series = '94' AND p1.ItemCode = T0.ItemCode), 0)
        -- Para los demás proveedores, mostrar transitStock en ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO
        WHEN (T8.SuppName != 'PRATAC S.A.' AND T8.SuppName != 'PERNOD RICARD COLOMBIA S.A.' AND T8.SuppName != 'RUM TRADING INTERNACIONAL CORP') 
             AND T3.WhsName = 'ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO' THEN 
            ISNULL((SELECT SUM(p1.Quantity * p1.NumPerMsr) 
                    FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.POR1 p1
                    LEFT JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OPOR op ON op.DocEntry = p1.DocEntry 
                    WHERE op.DocStatus = 'O' AND op.Series = '94' AND p1.ItemCode = T0.ItemCode), 0)
        ELSE 0
    END AS "transitStock",
    T1.IsCommited        AS "openDemandOrders",
    T9.U_DIAS_TRANSITO AS transitDays,
    T9.U_DIAS_NACIONALIZACION_PUERTO AS nationalGyeDays,
    T9.U_DIAS_NACIONALIZACION_UIO AS nationalUioDays,
    CASE 
        WHEN T8.CardCode = 'P20532416036' THEN 'P8300318491'
        ELSE T8.CardCode
    END AS CardCode,
    CASE 
        WHEN T8.SuppName = 'PRATAC S.A.' THEN 'PERNOD RICARD COLOMBIA S.A.'
        ELSE T8.SuppName
    END AS SuppName
FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITM T0
INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITW T1 
    ON T0.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITB T6 
    ON T0.ItmsGrpCod = T6.ItmsGrpCod
INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 
    ON T1.WhsCode = T3.WhsCode
CROSS JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OADM T2
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        T7.ItemCode,
        MAX(T8.DocEntry) AS LatestDocEntry
    FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.IPF1 T7
    INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OIPF T8 
        ON T7.DocEntry = T8.DocEntry
    WHERE T8.DocDate > '2000-01-01'
    GROUP BY T7.ItemCode
) LatestIPF 
    ON T0.ItemCode = LatestIPF.ItemCode
LEFT JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OIPF T8 
    ON LatestIPF.LatestDocEntry = T8.DocEntry
LEFT JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OCRD T9 ON (T8.CardCode  = T9.CardCode )
WHERE  T1.WhsCode IN (
 SELECT WhsCode 
        FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OWHS 
        WHERE WhsName IN (
            'ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO',
            'CORDOVEZ GUAYAQUIL'
        )
    )
    AND T0.validFor = 'Y'
    AND T8.CardCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL

SELECT 
    CASE
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL UIO REV'
        WHEN T3.WhsName = 'REVECUADOR GUAYAQUIL' THEN 'ALMACEN GENERAL GYE REV'
    ELSE T3.WhsName
    END AS "location",
    T1.ItemCode AS "code",
    T0.DocDate AS "date",
    T1.Quantity AS "quantity"
FROM [DB_REVECUADOR_PROD].dbo.OINV T0
JOIN [DB_REVECUADOR_PROD].dbo.INV1 T1 ON T1.DocEntry = T0.DocEntry
JOIN [DB_REVECUADOR_PROD].dbo.OITM T2 ON T2.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
JOIN [DB_REVECUADOR_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 ON T3.WhsCode = T1.WhsCode
WHERE 
T0.U_DOC_DECLARABLE = 'S' AND
T0.DocDate  BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CAST(GETDATE() as DATE)
AND  T3.WhsName IN ('ALMACÉN GENERAL UIO','REVECUADOR GUAYAQUIL')
Order By T1.WhsCode, T1.ItemCode, T0.DocDate
